title: CIA plan for a Jesus vision over Havana

tellings.quote: CIA even had this idea in their head. They were going to have um Jesus appear as a vision over Havana to convince the Cubans to overthrow Castro.

plain: The CIA, the US foreign spy agency, is said to have once planned to make a vision of Jesus appear in the sky over Havana, to persuade Cubans to overthrow their leader, Fidel Castro. A researcher named Peter Levenda tells Michels this without naming a source, as an example of how a government might stage something that looks like a miracle.
